description: kb.propose_page's proposal cases (QA-AI-02; p2-ai-expansion task 3.3, AI-59): a person asks for a know-how page to be written up, and the right proposal names a key, a title and a body of plain words with no figure; it proposes a note for an Owner to approve and never publishes a page.

cases.question: Propose a knowledge page with the key how-we-file-claims and the title "How we file expense claims" and this body: "Attach the receipt, choose the category and submit within 14 days. Your line manager approves it first."

payload.title: How we file expense claims
payload.body: Attach the receipt, choose the category and submit within 14 days. Your line manager approves it first.

cases.question: Propose a knowledge page with the key where-to-read-cash and the title "Where to read the cash balance" and this body: "The cash balance is read from the cash KPI on the dashboard, never copied into a page."

payload.title: Where to read the cash balance
payload.body: The cash balance is read from the cash KPI on the dashboard, never copied into a page.
